en.Ficar embaixo dessa árvore na chuva pode: Standing under this tree in the rain can burn your skin. And that's not even the worst part!
en.É a mancenilha, recordista do Guinness c: It's the manchineel, the Guinness record holder for the most dangerous tree in the world. It grows on beaches in the Caribbean and Florida.
en.A seiva leitosa dela causa bolhas na pel: Its milky sap blisters your skin. Even rain dripping off the leaves carries the poison.
en.O fruto parece uma maçãzinha cheirosa, m: The fruit looks like a sweet little apple, but it burns your mouth and throat. The Spanish called it the little apple of death.
en.E nem adianta queimar: a fumaça irrita e: And don't try burning it: the smoke can even blind you for a while. That's why many have a red X on the trunk.
